Name: Washbasin
Description: A ceramic bathroom washbasin and its tap (RunningWaterSpec.Washbasin): off until somebody turns it on with the interact key; its plug starts in, so it fills while the tap runs and stands full when it is shut. Shift+E at the basin facing it works the plug: pulled, it drains and gurgles. Place it over the basin. Not a recording and not a loop.
